note: Corrected car prompts. Output goes to art-review/ NOT public/assets — candidates must pass the likeness review in docs/CAR_LIKENESS.md before any becomes a master. Run: npm run art:regen-cars
recipe: No upper grille opening + one unusual proportion pairing. Validated against two alternatives: naming invented design features (a hexagonal grille split by a vertical bar) produced a badged BMW, because those features ARE a real marque signature. Removing the grille removes both the signature and the surface a badge sits on.
